howTo.intro: Three ways to get your convention's schedule into ConPaws.

find.title: ConPaws catalog
find.summary: Your con might already be in ConPaws. Download its schedule in a couple of taps.

search.title: Search for your con
search.body: Search the catalog by your convention's name or city. This step needs an internet connection.

check.title: Check the details
check.body: Tap your convention to see its dates, venue and time zone, and whether its schedule is ready.

download.title: Download the schedule
download.body: Tap {{button}}. Once it's saved, the schedule works without an internet connection.

notListed.title: Not listed yet?
notListed.body: Not every convention is in the catalog yet. Tap {{button}} to bring in a Sched link or a calendar file instead.

sched.title: Sched link
sched.summary: Many cons publish their schedule on Sched. Copy its address and paste it into ConPaws.

open.title: Open your con's Sched page
open.body: Open your convention's schedule in your browser. A Sched address ends in .sched.com.

copy.title: Copy the address
copy.body: Copy it from the address bar or the Share menu. Any page from that Sched site works.

paste.title: Paste it into ConPaws
paste.body: On the {{screen}} screen, paste the address under {{field}}, then tap {{button}}.

review.title: Check it, then import
review.body: If the schedule has categories, pick the ones you want. Check the time zone, then tap the import button at the bottom. ConPaws can check a link for schedule changes later.

ics.title: Calendar file
ics.summary: Got an .ics file or a webcal:// link from your con's website? ConPaws reads both.

find.title: Find the calendar link
find.body: On your convention's website, look for a link such as "Add to calendar", "Calendar feed", "Subscribe" or "Export".

save.title: Copy the link
save.body: Press and hold the link and copy it. A webcal:// or .ics link works. If you already have the .ics file, keep it on your phone for the next step.

add.title: Add it to ConPaws
add.body: On the {{screen}} screen, paste the link under {{field}} and tap {{fetch}}. Have a file instead? Tap {{button}} and pick it.

review.title: Check it, then import
review.body: If the schedule has categories, pick the ones you want. Check the time zone, then tap the import button at the bottom. A file won't update by itself, but ConPaws can check a link for changes later.

import.title: Import Schedule
import.linkHelp: Works with a Sched address, a direct .ics link, or a webcal:// link copied from the convention's calendar.
import.fileDescription: Choose an .ics file exported by the convention.
import.cancellation: {{count}} event was cancelled by the convention
import.cancellations: {{count}} events were cancelled by the convention
import.emptyUpdateMessage: You'll review the exact removal count before anything changes.

timeZone.label: Convention time zone
timeZone.help: Use the convention's location, not your phone's current location.
timeZone.requiredMessage: Choose the convention's time zone before importing — pick the city the convention is in.

errors.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like a schedule link. Paste a Sched address, an .ics link, or a webcal:// link.
errors.reversedSchedUrl: Sched addresses are the other way round. Try {{suggestion}} instead.
errors.network: ConPaws couldn't reach that link. Check the address, then your connection.
errors.invalidResponse: That link opened a web page, not a calendar file. On the convention's schedule page, look for Export, Subscribe, or Add to calendar.
errors.tooLarge: That schedule is too large to import. Convention feeds are normally well under 8MB — check the link points at a schedule and not a whole archive.
errors.noEvents: No events were found in this calendar file.
errors.parse: This calendar couldn't be parsed safely.
errors.unsupportedRecurrence: This calendar uses unsupported active recurrence definitions ({{properties}}). ConPaws can't safely expand them yet. Export an expanded .ics file with each occurrence as its own event, then try again.

alerts.emptyUpdateEvent: This Sched update has no active events. Applying it will remove exactly {{count}} imported event from this convention and cancel its local reminder. Manually added events will stay.
alerts.emptyUpdateEvents: This Sched update has no active events. Applying it will remove exactly {{count}} imported events from this convention and cancel their local reminders. Manually added events will stay.
alerts.invalidTimeZoneMessage: Pick the convention's time zone from the list, such as Chicago.
alerts.parseNotApplied: This calendar couldn't be parsed safely. Nothing was changed.
alerts.updateNotAppliedMessage: The app couldn't verify which imported events would be removed. Nothing was changed.
alerts.unresolvedSeries: Recurring series left unchanged: {{count}}. Older saved events couldn't be matched safely.
alerts.detailsNotUpdated: Events were saved, but the convention dates or saved Sched URL couldn't be refreshed.

help.title: Where do I find this?
help.sched: Most conventions publish their schedule on Sched — the site looks like <name>.sched.com. Copy any page from it and paste it here.
help.ics: An .ics file is a standard calendar export. Conventions often link it as "Add to calendar" or "Calendar feed" — webcal:// links work too.
help.ask: Check the convention's website or app for a schedule link, or ask their social media which format they publish.

import.previewFooter: Nothing is saved until you tap Import.

welcome.subtitle: Find your convention or bring an .ics file or Sched link.
welcome.connectionNote: A connection is needed to find and download schedules. Your downloaded schedule stays available offline.

features.subtitle: Tap the star to save an event. Then open My plan to see your pick.
features.practiceNote: Try it here. This sample will not change your conventions.
features.viewsNote: Browse shows the schedule. My plan holds your picks. Now shows what is happening now and next.
features.emptyPlan: Nothing planned yet. Go to Browse and tap the star.
